target.description: Path to the target git repository. Default is current directory.

rules.description: List of rules to configure. Each rule has id (required), enabled (bool), and options (dict). See official docs for rule names and options. Example: [{id='T1', enabled=false}, {id='B1', options={'line-length': 100}}].

extra_paths.description: Comma-separated list of paths (directories or Python modules) with user-defined or contrib rules.

ignore_rules.description: List of rule IDs or names to ignore (comma-separated).

contrib_rules.description: List of contrib rule IDs or names to enable.
